INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — MOCK EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Reading 1.2.1 Reading comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.2.1 Reading comprehension.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.2.1 Reading comprehension.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 1.2.1 Reading comprehension.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Reading 1.2.1 Reading comprehension.

2. When practising Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening.

   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening.

3. In INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Mix random languages with no purpose
   B. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   C. Only memorise without using the language
   D. Avoid speaking to classmates

   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for comprehension.

   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 2.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library Skills.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Reading 2.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library Skills.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading 2.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library Skills.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 2.2.1 Extensive Reading: Library Skills.

   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
12. In three clear sentences, explain Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 3.2.1 Extensive reading: Vocabulary building and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
